subject: Disrupted Circadian Rhythms Linked to Elevated Dementia Risk
script: From Agewell Brief: Disrupted Circadian Rhythms Linked to Elevated Dementia Risk. New research indicates that circadian misalignment may heighten dementia risk, reflecting chronobiology's foundational principle that human physiology is tuned to ancestral light-dark cycles. Circadian disruption is associated with increased dementia risk in a recent report. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
